stem: A student wants to make a change to the circuit shown below so that when Switch 1 is open and Switch 2 is closed, only one light will be on in the circuit.
instruction: Which diagram shows how the student should change the circuit?
visual_elements: Original circuit with Switch 1, Switch 2, three light bulbs, and a battery.
Four circuit diagrams labeled F, H, G, and J showing different wiring and switch configurations.
notes: Answer choices are diagrams labeled F, H, G, J with no additional text.
